_comment: Copy to C:\ProgramData\Prism\Agent\config.json (install.ps1 writes this for you, or deploy it via an Intune config profile). Absent or empty GatewayUrl => the agent spools locally only.
_ServerCertThumbprint_note: Leave null for the Azure Container Apps managed domain (publicly trusted + rotated). Only set this if the gateway uses a custom domain whose server cert you control.
_CompressUploads_note: gzip batches before upload (~10x smaller). Requires the gateway from the same release (it decompresses on Content-Encoding).
